findings.title: Reported impact
findings.statement: Classify the explicitly reported customer impact. Missing impact information means unknown.

findings.title: Investigation area
findings.statement: Choose the first investigation area directly supported by the symptoms. This is a lead, not a root-cause finding.
findings.guidance: Use this lead to choose an existing runbook; corroborate it with telemetry.

findings.title: Compatibility concern
findings.statement: Does the proposed change explicitly remove or incompatibly alter a public API, data format, or consumer contract?
findings.guidance: Review consumers and plan a compatible transition.

findings.title: Data migration concern
findings.statement: Does the proposed change modify persisted data or its schema?
findings.guidance: Review migration ordering, backups, and recovery with the data owner.

findings.title: Access control concern
findings.statement: Does the proposed change alter authentication, authorization, or credential handling?
findings.guidance: This concern is not established by the supplied context. Confirm against the actual change.

findings.guidance: Document and exercise a rollback procedure.
